VSE.Expertise.ExpertiseDef.label: Demolition

VSE.Expertise.ExpertiseDef.label: Larceny
VSE.Expertise.ExpertiseDef.description: An expertise in finding more valuable items when stealing from others without being caught.\n\n(Pilfering stealth allows you to command this character to pickpocket non-player characters or burglarize non-player settlements on visiting them.)

VSE.Expertise.ExpertiseDef.label: Skulduggery
VSE.Expertise.ExpertiseDef.description: An expertise in stealing from others without being caught.\n\n(Pilfering stealth allows you to command this character to pickpocket non-player characters or burglarize non-player settlements on visiting them.)

VSE.Expertise.ExpertiseDef.label: Gautending
VSE.Expertise.ExpertiseDef.description: An expertise in supporting dryads from tended Gauranlen trees.

VSE.Expertise.ExpertiseDef.label: Gauscaping
VSE.Expertise.ExpertiseDef.description: An expertise in supporting dryads from tended Gauranlen trees.

VSE.Expertise.ExpertiseDef.label: Recycling
VSE.Expertise.ExpertiseDef.description: An expertise in the recycling of pollution and its byproducts.

VSE.Expertise.ExpertiseDef.label: Ambusher
